model: eQ AHU controls (Climatix), application eQ Fläkt AHU V2.xx
applies_to: FläktGroup eQ air handling units with Siemens Climatix POL6xx controls running the eQ Fläkt AHU application V2.xx.
summary: eQ air handling units use a Siemens Climatix POL6xx controller; a plug-in Climatix BACnet IP (POL908) or MS/TP (POL904) module exposes the eQ Fläkt V2.xx application. The list covers temperatures, pressures, flows, fan data, coil and heat-recovery output signals, setpoints and PID parameters, alarm inputs and values, operating mode and status multistates, schedules and calendars.
notes: The guide prints object name, description, instance, values/units and the software version that introduced the object, with no access column; writable properties are given per object type only, so every object is shown as R. Check write access on site for command objects such as OpModeBmsTimeStSwtch and ExtSetpointSpvCOM.
Descriptions marked SW 2.xx+ were introduced in that application version; unmarked ones exist in 2.40 and earlier.

Page 25 of the guide prints the description column one row low from HumMaxCtrLoopKp to the end of the page (units and instances stay on the right rows). The V3.xx table prints the same objects with the same instances correctly aligned, so the descriptions here follow that.
AI 45150 SupplyTmp is printed with values 0=Ok / 1=Alarm instead of a unit.
V3.xx software has a different object set; see the eQ Fläkt V3.xx list.

source.title: eQ Controls - Climatix BACnet communication module, Installation and maintenance instruction (BACnet objects of eQ Fläkt V2.xx)

integration.summary: Fit a Climatix BACnet IP (POL908) or MS/TP (POL904) module, set its network parameters on the controller and export the EDE file. Command the unit with the BMS time-switch-program objects (OpModeBmsTimeStSwtch or the steps/temperature variant) and the bus setpoint, then read operating mode, status, temperatures, fan signals and the alarm-class objects.

minimum_points.name: OpModeBmsTimeStSwtch
minimum_points.why: BMS operating command: 0 Auto, 1 Off, 2-4 stage 1-3

minimum_points.name: ExtSetpointSpvCOM
minimum_points.why: Temperature setpoint written over the bus, °C

integration.enable: The document gives no access column. OpModeBmsTimeStSwtch (steps) and OpModeBmsTimeStTmpSwtch (steps/temperature) are the BMS time-switch-program commands (0 = Auto follows the unit's own program); which one applies depends on the unit's control mode.
integration.remote_sensors: ExtSetpointSpvCOM (AV 1884) is the external setpoint value from communication; the AI ExtSetpointSpv is the hard-wired external setpoint input.
setup: BACnet IP module POL908 or MS/TP module POL904 plugs onto the Climatix POL6xx controller; network settings are made on the controller.
EDE files can be exported from the controller for the BMS database.
Instance numbers are fixed by the Climatix application (they look random, e.g. OutTmp = AI 53218).
gotchas: Climatix alarms are acknowledged as a whole, not per object; BACnet acknowledge does not clear pending Climatix alarms. The guide names a MultiStateValue 'Reset' for general acknowledgement.
Objects for options the unit does not have (ReCooler, extra heating/cooling, OJ-DV fan diagnostics) still appear in the list.
Multistate values are printed starting at 0; check the State_Text on site.
